fields.planning_notes: When Wildlife is selected, include quiet urban birdwatching around the mini-forest and planted areas during public visiting hours. This is observation of free-ranging city birds, not a zoo, Philippine-eagle encounter or guaranteed sighting. Observe without feeding, chasing or handling birds. The survey's early-morning research access does not override the park's public opening hours. Visit duration remains a planning allowance, not a published fixed tour length.
